messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty autopage fired for prometheus-scrape-job — alert: missing_scrapes (alert_id=pd-trigger-3345). 18 scrape targets not seen in the last 2m. Escalation level: 1.

ava: ack from PD, taking this. pinging for owner and impact. which cluster/region?

pagerduty: Ack recorded by ava — incident status: acknowledged.

marco: looking into metrics pipeline. seeing massive kafka consumer lag on topic `metrics-ingest-fanout` (group=metrics-ingest-consumers). Consumer lag ~900k, backlog ~1.1M.

jules: customer-ops: several customers reporting metrics missing since ~10:17 UTC, high priority tenants flagged. Sharing customer list to ops DM.

logs-service: We are emitting 503s from logstore when pushing to kafka; circuit backpressure enabled. Sample error from host prom-fanout-4:

```
2026-03-12T10:18:03Z ERROR push.go:142 failed to write to kafka: 503 ServiceUnavailable: kafka cluster temporarily rejecting writes
stack: push -> fanout -> kafka-producer
```

ops-eng: noticed increased GC pressure on prom-fanout pods 3-5. Pod 4 shows OOM frequently. cpu/mem spike coincident with scrape burst at 10:16.

ava: rolling restart on prom-fanout-4 to clear bad JVM state. will cordon and drain 4 first.

marco: can we temporarily reduce scrape fanout rate for low-priority customers to relieve backpressure?

ava: yes, applying routing config to throttle non-critical scrape targets (reducing fanout multiplier to 0.4). Doing now.

incident-bot: action initiated: update routing policy `fanout.rate_multiplier=0.4` for group=public-scrapes.

ops-eng: routing change applied. Immediate drop in outgoing requests to kafka from prom-fanout services (~58% reduction).

ava: restarted prom-fanout-4, it came back healthy. observing metrics — producer error rate dropping.

logs-service: kafka lag growth rate slowed, consumer group catch-up started. Current lag 780k and decreasing.

marco: triggering auto-scale on metrics-consumers +3 instances to increase consumption throughput (policy: burst-scale).

incident-bot: autoscale action: scaled `metrics-ingest-consumers` by +3 replicas.

jules: ops -> customers: drafting notification now, ETA for catch-up?

ava: estimated 18-25 minutes to catch up given current throughput, will update if changes.

marco: temporary mitigation: also routed non-essential exporters to fallback aggregator to avoid re-triggering. Applied `fallback=true` for exporters tagged low-priority.

ops-eng: confirm consumer throughput improved after scale; kafka consumer throughput steady at ~120k msg/s aggregate. Lag trending down.

ava: good. I'll keep monitoring for 30m, then hand off to night oncall. Marco, you'll take handoff in 25m.

jules: I'll post a customer-facing update in #customer-ops now (template: short description, affected tenants, ETA, mitigations).

marco: noted. follow-ups for postmortem: root cause appears to be cascading failure when logstore pushes hit transient 503s — retry loop ballooned memory and blocked fanout threads. Action items: add circuit-breaker, improve backpressure handling, increase consumer headroom.

ava: agree. also add a quick alert to detect repeated 503 spikes from logstore so we can autoscale earlier.

pagerduty: Incident assignment updated: ava -> marco. Incident remains acknowledged.

incident-bot: closing autopage on PD (pd-trigger-3345) — followups will continue in this thread.

ops-eng: current status: error rate down, kafka lag decreasing, low-priority scrape traffic throttled, restarted unhealthy pod.

jules: customer update posted. Some enterprises asked for expanded timeline; shared ETA 25m and will update as we close.

ava: handing to @marco for overnight monitoring. Final note before handoff: rolling restart cleared JVM OOM, throttling + consumer scale mitigated pressure; still want a postmortem.

marco: taking handoff. I will run the catch-up dashboard and watch consumer lag until <1000. will open incident in incidents tracker with action items.

ava: thx — marking handoff done. :white_check_mark:

jules: will follow up with customers when we hit steady state.

incident-bot: thread timestamp 1765432100 — last update 1765432500.

marco: quick note for postmortem: capture timeline, metrics-ingest consumer lag graphs, prom-fanout pod heap/GC traces, and logstore 503 spike traces.

ava: adding to follow-up checklist.

ops-eng: closing monitoring loop — will add alert for sustained producer 5xx spike >1m.

jules: closing customer comms when all affected tenants report metrics restored.

marco: will create RFC for circuit-breaker + backpressure improvements next week.

incident-bot: incident thread archived to /incidents/1765432100 for postmortem writeup. :page_with_curl:
